name: Voxel Neighbor Packing with Directional Iteration
aliases: Voxel Data Processing with Neighbor Packing and Directional Iteration
definition: A method to process voxel data efficiently by packing four neighboring voxels into one INT32 variable ('dummy') to allow skipping zero regions, while maintaining correct back-to-front rendering order based on a pre-computed boolean 'forward.x'.
summary: Voxel Neighbor Packing with Directional Iteration accelerates ray traversal by packing four voxels into a 32-bit integer for bulk zero-skipping, differing from Z-axis RLE by using fixed-width subcubes.
